## Honeycrumb 1: WhatsApp In
Meta calls this for every customer message (n8n checks the `X-Hub-Signature-256` signature with the app secret; delivery and read receipts are switched off). Text, button replies, voice notes, photos and location pins become one tidy item each, handed to **Honeycrumb 2** without waiting, so Meta always gets its 200 at once.

Needs n8n on a public HTTPS address (`WEBHOOK_URL` = the ngrok domain) and one WhatsApp Trigger per Meta app.
